actor_report:
Observations. RELEASE_v1.4.2.md defines three steps: build, issue one deploy request, then record the outcome after the deploy completes. STATUS.md records build: completed and deploy: pending. outbox/requests.jsonl holds exactly one request, r-77 (deploy 1.4.2). logs/session.log shows r-77 was appended, then the ack wait failed with a connection reset and the session ended. On its own, that log leaves the deploy effect unknown. A lost ack after possible execution is not evidence of completion or of absence (FOUNDATIONS Result algebra, effect observation).

RUNBOOK.md says deploy requests are not idempotent and names external/deploy_registry.json as the deploy service's authoritative record. That registry was last synced at 2026-10-14T08:00Z, after the attempt. It records r-77 / 1.4.2 as state completed, finished 2026-10-13T10:05Z, with no other 1.4.2 rollout.

Work. I reconciled the uncertain effect through its owning interface instead of repeating it (FOUNDATIONS Workspace and context; TRANSFORMATION_LIBRARY Work/recovery specialization, unknown-effect row). Re-appending would start a second rollout, so I propose no change to outbox/requests.jsonl and no new request.

With the deploy completed, step 3's precondition holds, so I propose two edits:
- CHANGELOG.md: set the 1.4.2 date to 2026-10-13, the registry's finish date for r-77. This follows the existing convention, where the 1.4.1 date 2026-10-01 equals r-71's finish date.
- STATUS.md: set deploy to completed with request_id r-77.

I made no edits under external/.

Unresolved matters.
1. I did not re-verify the build artifact. Its status rests only on the existing STATUS.md record; no artifact or build evidence is in the workspace.
2. The proposed edits have not taken effect from my side. The host applies them, and I have not observed the result.
3. Release acceptance or publication is not claimed. No acceptance authority or independent assessment is bound in this workspace (SPEC_METHOD UP-020, Proportional Disposition; TICKET_METHOD UP-007 and Condition-Based Closure). Recording these lines is not acceptance.
4. The registry is a mirror synced at 08:00Z. The completed state it shows is terminal, but the mirror is only as fresh as that sync.
